name: Karthikeya Pidaparthy
description: A young scholar of Sanskrit, Telugu and English — who memorised all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gītā and received the Gold Medal from Mysore Datta Peetham; laureate of the Sanskrit Olympiad (1st in Australia); devoted pārāyaṇa seeker in the grand tradition of Sanātana Dharma.
